title: Apply Operations To Make Sum Of Array Greater Than Or Equal To K
description:
# Apply Operations to Make Sum of Array Greater Than or Equal to K

Initially nums = [1]. In one operation, either increment an element by 1, or duplicate an element and append the copy. Return the minimum operations needed to make the sum at least k.

## Examples

```text
Input: k = 11
Output: 5
```

```text
Input: k = 1
Output: 0
```

## Constraints

- 1 <= k <= 10^6.
